patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than Sellfy's shape. Workflow advantage: Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace; Tiendanube leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce.; Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala .
- Company-size focus: Sellfy (micro, small-business) vs Tiendanube (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace vs Tiendanube-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Sellfy — none listed; Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market.

Limitations — Sellfy: —; Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth.

Poor-fit cases: Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Avoid Sellfy if you actually need Tiendanube's motion (LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inic) · Avoid Tiendanube if you actually need Sellfy's motion (Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner i)
